exposure: shared decision-making tool for opioid prescribing
provision of a home opioid deactivation system
outcome: mean number of 5-mg oxycodone tablets prescribed
percentage of women disposing of excess tablets
overall rate of patients utilizing all prescribed tablets or properly disposing of them
cohort: English-speaking women aged 18 years or older who delivered by cesarean section.
finding: Implementing a shared decision-making process, pain education, and opioid disposal tools resulted in 92% of post-cesarean patients either using all prescribed tablets or properly disposing of excess opioids, thereby reducing the community pool of unused medication.
mod_finding: The initiative effectively reduced the pool of unused opioid tablets among women specifically recovering from cesarean delivery.
